verdict.rationale: Runloop documents first-party recipes for running coding agents inside Devboxes. There is a dedicated OpenCode tutorial with a blueprint workflow, plus an Axon/ACP example that streams OpenCode output. Agent mounts provide pre-configured AI agents, PTY support covers TUIs that need a real TTY, and Agent Gateways let agents call Anthropic/OpenAI APIs without exposing keys. Missing for 10: a vendor recipe that explicitly names Claude Code or Codex CLI, and independent hands-on corroboration that these recipes work as documented.
